CustomField.description: The duration of the Outbound Flight
CustomField.formula: IF( FLOOR((Landing_Time_Outbound__c - Departing_Time_Outbound__c) * 24) = 0, "", TEXT(FLOOR((Landing_Time_Outbound__c - Departing_Time_Outbound__c) * 24)) & " Hour" & IF(FLOOR((Landing_Time_Outbound__c - Departing_Time_Outbound__c) * 24) > 1, "s", "") & ", " ) & TEXT(MOD((Landing_Time_Outbound__c - Departing_Time_Outbound__c) * 1440, 60)) & " Minute" & IF(MOD((Landing_Time_Outbound__c - Departing_Time_Outbound__c) * 1440, 60) <> 1, "s", "")
CustomField.label: Flight Duration (Outbound)
